goal: Schritt 1: Zwei-Schritt-Iterationsdisziplin verbindlich festlegen | Schritt 2: Governance-Gate und Standardplan daran ausrichten

guide_delta.summary: Künftig werden zwei direkt zusammengehörige Arbeiten in einem gemeinsamen Branch und PR erledigt. Nach Schritt 1 gibt es einen Zwischencheck; Schritt 2 läuft nur bei Grün. Dadurch sinken unnötige Branch-, PR- und CI-Zyklen, ohne Sicherheitsgrenzen aufzuweichen.

tests_required: Schritt 1: human-readable two-step rules and machine-rule markers present
Schritt 2: governance validator enforces all new markers and machine rules
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because product code is untouched
TUI/browser/database regressions because runtime and frozen core are untouched
full suite because this is governance-only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: forcing two unrelated tasks into one iteration would reduce clarity; the new rule therefore requires shared scope
step two must never bypass a failed intermediate gate or a separate freeze/reopen boundary
the current Manifest V2 schema remains unchanged to avoid schema churn; enforcement is through AGENTS, machine rules, template defaults and governance validation
non_changes: previously planned FieldType text-catalog work is deferred to the next product iteration
expected_side_effects: future iterations plan exactly two sequential work steps
two directly dependent small tasks share one branch, PR and final merge
step two is blocked rather than forced when step one is not green
final freeze occurs only after both steps are completed or step two is explicitly blocked
